title: Comment "Canva" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude + Canva is a literal money printer
description: Comment "Canva" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude + Canva is a literal money printer. You can now create hundreds of Canva designs directly inside Claude in less than an hour. Flyers, Instagram carousels, banners, posters—all automated inside Claude. Here's how to set it up in 2 minutes: 1. Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors 2. Search for Canva and click Add That's it. Canva is connected. Now ask Claude to generate as many designs as you want in your brand style without lifting a finger. You can open any design in Canva to edit every element. The craziest part? Post everything straight to social media without ever leaving Claude. #ai #claude #canva #design #contentcreation
